gaps.term: H lies after D on the tape
gaps.quote: each combining $D$ with $H$, which lies after $D$ on the tape, in linear time
gaps.note: Wrong order. The paper (Lemma matrix-shear, line ~1397: 'every H_i before every D_j'; line ~1518: 'The other two updates target the later group and have linear cost'; line ~1432: 'target a later field controlled by an earlier field') has H before D on the tape. The two linear-cost updates change the later field D using the earlier field H, which is what makes them linear-time. The page's 'after' contradicts the shear convention and breaks the stated reason for linear cost.

gaps.quote: the paper's proof computes $s$ as $Wm/2$ minus a positive constant fixed by the construction
gaps.note: Wrong value. The paper (Proposition bit-motif-interface, lines ~1148-1152) has s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b, with deficit N - 2L_b > 0 from W_b m, so s is Wm minus a positive constant, not Wm/2 minus a constant. The relative deficit is tiny (eta_b = 339/22587335000000, line ~1321). Wm/2 would also be inconsistent with the page's own need for s/W to be close to m (so that tau is close to 1).

gaps.quote: for the bit procedure this ring is $\mathbb F_2$, where subtraction and addition coincide
gaps.note: Misstates the ring. In the paper (Lemma matrix-shear, lines ~1396-1405, and Proposition power-interchange, line ~1494) the fields H, D range over [q^b] and the shear and the three updates are over Z/q^b Z for a fixed odd prime q chosen to avoid denominators of the rational matrices. Over an odd modulus subtraction and addition do not coincide, so the three updates D-H, H+D, H-D do not collapse to XORs of the address fields. XOR is only the gate applied pointwise to the stored bits of the role streams. The later claim that 'each update is a pointwise XOR' on the fields is therefore not what the paper states.

gaps.quote: each of its $s$ smaller calls acts on one role stream of volume $V/W$
gaps.note: Missing hypothesis. The paper (Proposition power-interchange, lines ~1486-1487 and the proof at ~1500-1510) obtains W role streams of volume V/W only by splitting whole rows cyclically, and requires a row field preceding both chunks whose length is divisible by W^k (rows are padded in Lemma chunk-swap, lines ~1672-1690). The page never mentions rows or this divisibility condition, and it states the V/W reduction and the final O(Vu^tau) bound for all arrays without it.
